video_title: NBA Offseason FRENZY Continues! Jaylen Brown to The 76ers, Lakers Get a Haul & New Rules to the NBA?

quotes.speaker: Paul Pierce
quotes.summary_phrase: Paul Pierce on the inevitability of the Jaylen Brown trade
quotes.excerpt: I came to acceptance of it that was going to happen although I don't like it.
quotes.quote: It's like if you have a family member who is dying and it's like when they die you saw it coming. It sucks, but you know, when it happens it's like out of the blue, it's different. You know what I'm saying? So it was like, all right. So I came to acceptance of it that was going to happen although I don't like it. I didn't want it to happen, but like I said, I don't know what happened behind the scenes where the relationship.

quotes.speaker: Danny Green
quotes.summary_phrase: Danny Green on Jaylen Brown's status as an All-NBA player
quotes.excerpt: It doesn't change the fact that he's a second all-NBA team guy.
quotes.quote: It doesn't change the fact that he's a second all-NBA team guy.

quotes.speaker: Paul Pierce
quotes.summary_phrase: Paul Pierce calls the Jaylen Brown trade a slap in the face
quotes.excerpt: I just think it's really a slap in the face of all-time great scorers.
quotes.quote: I just think it's really a slap in the face of all-time great scorers. When you look at the list to say, hey, this guy makes one free throw, you just give him points. You just give him three.

quotes.speaker: Danny Green
quotes.summary_phrase: Danny Green's disappointment with the Jaylen Brown trade return
quotes.excerpt: I was in shock because of where he got traded to.
quotes.quote: We knew that he was getting traded, but I was in shock because of where he got traded to. So that's where the disappointment lies in me. And also what they got in return. And that's no disrespect to Paul George. I think he's still a heck of a player.

quotes.speaker: Wosny Lambre
quotes.summary_phrase: Wosny Lambre cites Celtics staff on Derek White's performance
quotes.excerpt: Well, realistically, Derek White had a better season than him last year.
quotes.quote: Well, realistically, Derek White had a better season than him last year.

quotes.speaker: Paul Pierce
quotes.summary_phrase: Paul Pierce criticizes Wosny Lambre for reporting the Derek White comparison
quotes.excerpt: For the simple fact Wosny reported that, I'm disappointed in him.
quotes.quote: For the simple fact Wosny reported that, I'm disappointed in him. No, seriously. I don't care. Like for the simple fact you reported that and made that a public something that was news, don't even make fucking sense.

quotes.speaker: Paul Pierce
quotes.summary_phrase: Paul Pierce on the lack of interest in a Jaylen Brown extension
quotes.excerpt: There's definitely a sense like you would never do this to Jason Tatum.
quotes.quote: There's definitely a sense like you would never do this to Jason Tatum. If Jason Tatum was up for an extension, he would fucking get it. And if you're Jaylen Brown and you feel like your contributions have been, if you want to say Jaylen Jason Tatum has done more, Jaylen Brown, he's like, I'm right there. I don't get to be treated in a way that's completely different from Jason Tatum. I shouldn't be treated by the franchise that way.

quotes.speaker: Paul Pierce
quotes.summary_phrase: Paul Pierce on the shift toward business-minded NBA ownership
quotes.excerpt: I would say more like a money thing, like long-term.
quotes.quote: I would say more like a money thing, like long-term. Because I think he will be up for an extension for a crazy number based on the season that he just had. And when you have new ownership that comes in, you're like, look, when you put up a check for this big for a franchise, you like start cutting costs right away. And you're like, well, in a year or two we're going to have to extend Jaylen Brown, whereas if we trade for him now, we can get somebody with the same type of money that's come off the books in a couple of years and don't have to worry about the long-term tax bill that's coming.

quotes.speaker: Wosny Lambre
quotes.summary_phrase: Wosny Lambre on the Celtics' reluctance to pay Jaylen Brown
quotes.excerpt: Luka was due for $350 million dollars in an extension and that's basically when they were like, we don't want to pull the trigger on that.
quotes.quote: Luka was due for $350 million dollars in an extension and that's basically when they were like, we don't want to pull the trigger on that.

quotes.speaker: Paul Pierce
quotes.summary_phrase: Paul Pierce on the business-first mentality of modern NBA owners
quotes.excerpt: In this day and era, these owners are more business people at the end of the day.
quotes.quote: In this day and era, these owners are more business people at the end of the day. And I'm okay with that, but I just don't think they're wrong with that.

quotes.speaker: Paul Pierce
quotes.summary_phrase: Paul Pierce on the Celtics' need for perimeter dominance
quotes.excerpt: We got to be so perimeter dominated, we need to be a team that gets paint touches.
quotes.quote: We got to be so perimeter dominated, we need to be a team that gets paint touches. We got to be better at that. Jaylen Brown was their best guy at doing that.

quotes.speaker: Paul Pierce
quotes.summary_phrase: Paul Pierce on the Celtics' lack of depth
quotes.excerpt: I think they have some depth issues.
quotes.quote: I think they have some depth issues.

quotes.speaker: Paul Pierce
quotes.summary_phrase: Paul Pierce on the Celtics' roster and the Eastern Conference
quotes.excerpt: I mean you added Paul George who is very serviceable for the Sixers.
quotes.quote: I mean you added Paul George who is very serviceable for the Sixers. We added Mitchell Robinson who like you just don't sign him if you're not trying to contend. So you know what I'm saying? It was weird to me. You sign Mitchell Robinson, I'm like, okay, they even more contention.

quotes.speaker: Danny Green
quotes.summary_phrase: Danny Green on the Celtics' status as contenders
quotes.excerpt: I don't see them as a contender anymore. I think Boston took two steps back.
quotes.quote: I don't see them as a contender anymore. I think Boston took two steps back.

quotes.speaker: Paul Pierce
quotes.summary_phrase: Paul Pierce on the Celtics' lack of guard play
quotes.excerpt: They don't have the guard play.
quotes.quote: They don't have the guard play. I like I love I love I like you don't have the guard play.

quotes.speaker: Paul Pierce
quotes.summary_phrase: Paul Pierce on the importance of guard play
quotes.excerpt: You need the guard play. Emmanuel Quickley didn't play a lot in the playoffs.
quotes.quote: You need the guard play. Emmanuel Quickley didn't play a lot in the playoffs or did he ever come back? Scotty Barnes would do a lot of the heavy lifting. Yeah, but they're not ready. They're not ready.

quotes.speaker: Paul Pierce
quotes.summary_phrase: Paul Pierce on the importance of coaching culture
quotes.excerpt: They have a top three culture.
quotes.quote: They have a top three culture. These things matter, do they not?

quotes.speaker: Paul Pierce
quotes.summary_phrase: Paul Pierce on the DraftKings odds for the Eastern Conference
quotes.excerpt: So let's look at the teams that DraftKings thinks are going to have the best records.
quotes.quote: So let's look at the teams that DraftKings thinks are going to have the best records, regular season. Not necessarily to come out the East, as we saw the top two seeds of the East got spanked, didn't make it out this year. Hell, the one seed damn near lost in the first round if it wasn't for Franz Wagner going down, right? But this is for regular season records.

quotes.speaker: Danny Green
quotes.summary_phrase: Danny Green on the volatility of NBA odds
quotes.excerpt: This is again, summertime. We don't know what the all this will change by November.
quotes.quote: This is again, summertime. We don't know what the all this will change by November. By Christmas time, it'll look way different than that. November, this is cool, but no, both of these are wrong to me.

quotes.speaker: Paul Pierce
quotes.summary_phrase: Paul Pierce on the Celtics' continuity
quotes.excerpt: But change is a lot though when you you let go of Jaylen Brown.
quotes.quote: But change is a lot though when you you let go of Jaylen Brown. The continuity has been a little interesting.
